CustomField.description: State of the automatic loan payment setup. Backs the two items the business flags as CRITICAL and frequently missed - F12 during closing prep and J4 post-closing at the lender bank. Suffixed Status__c per the naming convention because it expresses current state and does not drive a Path. Failed exists so a broken mandate is visible rather than silently indistinguishable from never set up.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether the automatic loan payment has been set up at the lender. Failed means a mandate was attempted and rejected.
CustomField.label: Auto Payment Status
